Office memo № 2
Comments live inside the document: notes, highlights, underlines and freehand
drawings. Ottisk opens documents, shows their pages and lets you work with them
without extra windows.
A form can be filled in, saved and sent; the total field recalculates on its own. When a
file is damaged, the program tries to rebuild the object table and reports it quietly.
A signature proves that the document has not changed since signing and who signed
it. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the river flows past the old
mill.
Every page is redrawn when the zoom level changes, so small print stays sharp and
readable. Text recognition turns a picture of a page into a document that search can
work with.
